The predeclared fit search loaded at its first setting (6.3 s).

Picked from a public model watch, downloaded at a fixed revision and checked by SHA-256, with its arms written and its fit searched before they ran; the conditional arm on the other topology ran after this model's planned arms had finished.

The first launch of this model's three arms (21:05 UTC on 20 October) stopped within seconds at a template gate, because of a reserved task-group label; the same arms, launch lines unchanged, were queued again and ran from 21:06 UTC. Those are the results here.
